verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly list this exact set of capabilities — writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies — as core use cases, backed by broader evidence of git integration, codebase understanding, and hooks for lint/format automation. Independent community reports confirm real-world use across multi-language codebases, though other community feedback raises general code-quality/reliability concerns not specific to these four tasks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically for merge-conflict resolution and dependency updates (most community evidence is about general coding quality, not these specific tasks).
